scientific_integrity: Closed-form minimax and exact spectral bounds proved analytically; finite verification corroborates but cannot certify universal claims.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic full-row-rank real matrices with equal unit row norms; relative descent uses equal operator-norm calibration. Neither an optimizer trajectory theorem nor a bound for unequal-row input statistics. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Sharp dimension-dependent calibration of row-normalized and polar directions
